description: Gandi LiveDNS, through its API, of a domain of the account whose name servers are LiveDNS. Each name's A and AAAA records are written as sets.

token.description: A personal access token that may manage the domain's technical configuration: in Gandi's account settings, under Authentication options.

ttl.description: The records' TTL, as 5m or 1h: 5m at the least, and a lower one is raised to it, with a warning. Default: 3h, Gandi's.
